name: Corpselight Mist
disable: DC 28 Religion check to counteract Kabriri's influence here by offering prayers to any non-evil deity and causing the mist to disperse, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the mist for 24 hours
reset: The hazard resets automatically at the end of a turn and can trigger again the next round.

items.name: Decay Flesh
items.text:
Trigger A creature ends its turn within the mist

---

Effect The mist swiftly decays the flesh of all living creatures in the pit, inflicting 10d6 void damage (DC 27 basic Fortitude save save).

text: Churning vapors of glowing green mist fill a 30-foot-deep chasm.
